exercises.task: Make Dog extend Animal and give it a bark() method. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: class Dog extends Animal { ... } — bark() can use this.name inherited from the parent.

exercises.task: Override describe() in Student to add the major, calling super first. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: super.describe() gives the parent's string — then add to it.

exercises.task: Write makeAllSpeak() that works for any Animal subclass. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Loop (or map) and call .speak() — each object answers in its own way.
